ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-24-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of 3 Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Cindy Fan, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Cindy Fan, Kevin Fan and Elvina Fan, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Cindy Angela Fan; Kevin Bill Fan and Elvina Diana Fan.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-30-2004 Denied
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Cindy Fan, present in pro per and as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Kevin Fan and Elvina Fan, was sworn and examined.
Petitioner to re-file the Petition for self and for the Minors, with proper proposed names listed on the petition.
Order is DENIED without prejudice and signed by Comm. Kaplan.
